name: docusetu-monorepo
description: DocuSetu - Intelligent Document Processing Platform for Global Supply Chain and Customs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:all: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd .. && npx esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=api/index.js --external:pdf-parse --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:api: npx esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=api/index.js --external:pdf-parse --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"

author: DocuSetu Engineering Team
